dct_description_sm: Click here for metadata. Wellhead Protection Areas (WHPA) are zones around a municipal well where land use activities have the potential to affect the quality of water supplying the well. There are four locations within the Quinte Source Protection Region where municipal groundwater supply systems exist: Peats Point Subdivision (Prince Edward County) - 1 well; Village of Deloro - 1 well; Village of Tweed - 2 wells; Village of Madoc - 2 wells. WHPA zones are classified: A - 100 metre radius; B - 2 Year Time of Travel; C - 5 Year Time of Travel; D 25 Year Time of Travel; E - 2 Hour Time of Travel in the surface water body contributing to well.
